source.title: Fel Iron Ore — archived Thottbot 565-ore prospecting report
source.author: Thottbot archive (individual commenter unidentified)

quote: Heres what i got after prospecting 565 fel iron ores
notes: Independent archived Thottbot first-person report states 565 Fel Iron Ore processed and 113 Fel Iron Powder plus these exact gem quantities. 565/5 = 113 nominal five-ore batch equivalents, corroborated by 113 powder units, but the contributor did NOT explicitly log completed casts; casts remains null. Powder implies historical pre-removal mechanics (removed in patch 3.0.2), but collection date and exact game build are unstated; patch left null. No per-output positive-cast counts, zero outcomes, stack histograms, profession skill, specialization, refunds, item rank or current Retail applicability reported. Original Thottbot commenter identity and photo availability unknown. Same archived comment appears on multiple Wowhead locale mirrors; treat all mirrors as ONE cohort. Do not convert item totals into measured P(hit), freeze prices, or conflate with the separate 100-ore Thottbot study.
